prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 9 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a landscape 16:9 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Mahawewa Canal; image 2 is the reference sheet for medical bag; image 3 is the reference sheet for C-17; image 4 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: medical bag exactly as shown; image 3: C-17 exactly as shown; image 4: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Aruni is the red mannequin; Nimal is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One painted image contains nine equal landscape panels in a 3-by-3 grid, read left to right and top to bottom, separated by narrow plain gutters. Heavy rain falls through diffuse grey dawn light, with faint amber near the horizon, deep bank-side shadows, muted greens, earthy reds and brown water. Aruni is a smooth red artist's mannequin of average height and compact, sturdy build; Nimal is a smooth blue artist's mannequin of average height and broad, solid build. Their surfaces carry restrained wet highlights, while props and surroundings are painted realistically. The medical bag is small and rectangular, navy with black piping, two short handles, a zippered top and scuffed lower corners; the key is worn yellow-grey metal with a rounded rectangular bow and circular hole; the smartphone is black with a dark protective case and rain-speckled glass. Draw no panel labels, captions, titles, arrows or readable lettering.

Geography: The muddy field-edge path approaches the sluice from screen left and continues toward screen right, with every camera remaining on the near, paddy-bank side. The canal runs beyond the path: its open brown reach and a distinctive triangular grass lip remain on frame left, while the weathered concrete sluice stands farther along at frame right. The approach panel shows that same open reach but excludes the sluice beyond its right edge; the arrival panels reveal the structure from closer along the connected bank. Nimal lies diagonally at the near-bank gate footing, head on the bank at screen right and feet toward the water at screen left, chest upward and right hand on the accessible near-bank side. Aruni approaches from the left and later kneels beside that right hand. Gate-side views retain open water on the left and algae-darkened concrete on the right; standing close framing includes distant vegetation, while kneeling close framing places nearby mud and the concrete footing behind the mannequin.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Standing-height, bank-side rear-three-quarter side view, looking obliquely across the path rather than along it; 35mm wide with deep focus. Background: Green paddy fills the left distance. Beyond the path, brown canal water and its triangular grass lip occupy the middle-left; the path crosses toward the right edge, with the sluice excluded beyond that edge. The red mannequin occupies the left third at roughly one quarter of panel height, caught mid-stride travelling across the frame toward screen right. Its chest and head point right, seen from a rear-three-quarter side angle rather than directly behind. Its left hand carries the navy medical bag beside the thigh, while its empty right hand hangs alongside the opposite hip.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Standing eye height on the near bank, looking across the arrival area toward the sluice; 40mm wide, both mannequins and structure readable. Background: The same brown-water reach and triangular grass lip remain at frame left, with paddy farther left. The stained concrete gate and its algae-darkened upright occupy frame right behind the blue mannequin. The red mannequin stands in the left third, chest facing screen right and head angled down-right toward the blue mannequin, left hand holding the bag and right hand empty. The blue mannequin lies across the lower right with chest upward, head at screen right and feet extending left toward the water. Its right fist rests closed beside the near side of its torso, completely hiding its contents, while its left hand rests alongside the far hip.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — At the standing mannequin's head height, approximately 1.55 metres, from the same bank side as the reveal; 85mm close-up with shallow focus. Background: Distant vegetation sits high at frame left above blurred brown water. The upper concrete gate upright remains a dark blurred shape at frame right. The red mannequin's head and upper shoulders fill the panel left of centre, with open space down-right. Its chest faces screen right and its head turns three-quarter down-right, never square to the camera. The bag-bearing left hand and empty right hand remain below the lower crop.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Low bank-side three-quarter position, approximately 0.65 metres high; 50mm two-shot with the upright red mannequin partly cropped above the frame and the blue mannequin's upper torso low at right. Background: Open brown water remains at left and damp concrete occupies the right background. A soft gate bar crosses the lower centre in the foreground. The red mannequin stands at frame left with its head and shoulders above the top crop, its visible torso facing screen right. Its left hand retains the medical bag, and its empty right hand hangs near the right thigh. The blue mannequin lies chest upward across the lower right, head at screen right, with its far arm resting alongside its torso. The foreground gate bar completely conceals the blue right fist and the space immediately beside it.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Bank-side camera approximately 0.45 metres above the fist, looking steeply downward through a clear gap beside the gate bar; 100mm macro insert. Background: Wet red-brown bank fills the soft background, with a narrow brown-water blur at upper left and damp concrete at the right edge. The blue right wrist enters from frame right, and its closed fist fills the panel diagonally toward the lower left. A small metal key remains trapped within the curled fingers, its toothed shaft concealed and its projecting bow centred toward the camera. Rain beads catch on the metal, whose identification engraving is suggested only by indistinct shallow impressions without readable characters.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 3) — At kneeling head height, approximately 0.85 metres, on the bank side; 85mm close-up with shallow focus. Background: Nearby muddy bank fills the lower background. A soft strip of grass-edged water remains at upper left, while the low concrete gate footing fills frame right; no distant horizon appears. The kneeling red mannequin's head and upper shoulders fill the panel left of centre, with its chest facing screen right. Its head is held in three-quarter view, angled down-right toward the space beside the blue mannequin. Below the crop, its left hand retains the bag beside the left knee and its empty right hand rests near the right thigh.
PANEL 7 (row 3, column 1) — Bank-side camera approximately 0.95 metres high, looking downward over the right forearm; 75mm insert with the phone surface sharp. Background: Wet bank recedes beneath the hands, with a faint water strip at upper left and the concrete footing at frame right. The navy bag enters at the far left edge. The red right hand holds the black smartphone centrally above the bent right thigh, its glass screen angled toward the camera and its thumb resting clear of the circular call control. The screen shows an anonymous contact icon and simple unlabelled interface shapes, without readable characters. At the far left edge, the red left hand still grips both short handles of the medical bag.
PANEL 8 (row 3, column 2) — Same bank-side position and kneeling head height as shot 6, approximately 0.85 metres; matching 85mm close-up and shallow focus. Background: The same nearby mud lies behind the lower part of the mannequin, with grass-edged water blurred at upper left and the concrete gate footing on frame right. The red mannequin's head fills the panel left of centre, tipped slightly farther down over its screen-right-facing chest. Its head remains three-quarter toward screen right, leaving dark space down-right. Both hands stay below the crop, the right holding the phone above the right thigh and the left retaining the bag beside the left knee.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 3) — Exact bank-side standing-height position and 40mm wide framing of shot 2, with deep focus. Background: The same open brown-water reach and triangular grass lip occupy frame left, with paddy farther left. The weathered sluice and algae-darkened upright remain behind the blue mannequin at frame right. The red mannequin now kneels in the left third beside the blue mannequin's near-side right hand, chest facing screen right and head angled down-right. Its right hand holds the phone low above the right thigh, while its left hand keeps the medical bag beside the left knee. The blue mannequin remains chest upward across the lower right, head right and feet left toward the water, left hand beside the far hip and right fist closed beside its torso. Only a tiny unlettered edge of the retained key projects from that fist.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
